oneLine: Embraer acquires a 51% stake in Novavayu Aerospace from Mahindra Group, providing a cash payout.

sources.title: Embraer announces deal to acquire 51% stake in Mahindra Group's Novavayu Aerospace: All you need to know

synopsis: Brazilian aerospace major Embraer has entered into an agreement to acquire a 51% majority stake in Novavayu Aerospace Limited, an Indian firm owned by the Mahindra Group, providing a cash payout. The deal is expected to be finalised by December 1, 2026. The transaction aims to strengthen Embraer's footprint in India's commercial aviation and defence industries, establishing a local corporate base as the company looks to expand its business operations in the country amidst rising demand for air travel and ongoing military modernization efforts.
